subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw establish `PluginHookAgentContext.api.resetSession(reason?)` as a supported after-compaction plugin contract?
rationale: The patch adds durable plugin authority over session lifecycle and changes compatibility-sensitive reset semantics across several runtime owners; repository history cannot determine that product/API choice automatically.

options.title: Approve the scoped API
options.body: Accept only the reason-only, current-session, after-compaction contract with caller-owned deferral, focused compatibility coverage, and complete live proof.

options.title: Keep reset recovery internal
options.body: Remove the public hook API and implement any required post-compaction recovery entirely inside the owning session and compaction runtimes.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped API
recommendation.body: Accept only the reason-only, current-session, after-compaction contract with caller-owned deferral, focused compatibility coverage, and complete live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history spans both the compaction-memory lifecycle and session reset policy affected by this API decision.
